blind_spots.blind_spot: Autonomy rests on GPS waypoints driven by an open-source ground station
blind_spots.operator_reality: The environments this kit is pitched into — range clearance, convoy lead/follow, route reconnaissance — are exactly where GPS is jammed or spoofed and where the control radio is contested. Mission Planner following fixed waypoints degrades to a vehicle that stops or drifts, and the operator's fallback is a teleop link with the same RF problem. The architectural fix is alternative navigation and a defined behavior on link loss, and neither appears in their language.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The Phase II was framed around Humanitarian Aid and Disaster Relief, where GPS and comms are degraded by terrain and infrastructure loss rather than by an adversary deliberately denying them.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Kairos currently utilizes Mission Planner, an open source drone-control program, to autonomously guide the UVC systems through fixed GPS waypoints.

blind_spots.blind_spot: Physical declassification is solved; the cyber authorization package is not
blind_spots.operator_reality: Pulling the computing module handles spillage, but the moment this vehicle joins a unit it is a system needing an RMF package, STIGs on that 'industry standard computing platform', and a story for a 14-port USB hub sitting on a fielded asset — removable media is one of the first findings an assessor writes up. Company-level CMMC/NIST 800-171 gates the contract before any of that. Nine to eighteen months of authorization work runs longer than most Phase II periods.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Their security instinct is physical and hardware-shaped, formed in an era when the kit lived on a test range rather than on an authorized network.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: The computing module contains an industry standard computing platform, as well as a 14 port USB hub and an 8 port Ethernet Switch.

blind_spots.blind_spot: No visible advocacy chain or program-of-record path after twenty years of kit sales
blind_spots.operator_reality: Range and test users loving an applique kit does not create a program. Without a sponsoring program office, a prime integration relationship, an NSN and a sustainment plan, each sale stays a one-off purchase order and the Phase II ends without a transition partner. That is the failure mode that kills the follow-on contract even when the hardware works — and here the hardware demonstrably works.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The go-to-market on the site is a catalog and a quote request, which is exactly what sustains a small business at 16 people and exactly what prevents it from becoming a program.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Want to get automated? Give us a message for any product questions, system quotes, or other information.

opener_hook: Your UVC Phase II abstract says the autonomy runs Mission Planner over fixed GPS waypoints, and the use cases on your homepage are range clearance and convoy lead/follow — the two environments where a range turns jamming on.
what_they_do: Bolt-on 'robotic applique' kits that convert any existing vehicle or vessel into a teleoperated or optionally-crewed unmanned system in minutes.
